method: Codex in-app browser manual UI checks

checks.name: Baseline lyric memories are absent
The selected lyric opens the correct place and trip time
Playback can continue in the conversation sheet
Closing the memory keeps playback position
Seeking changes the highlighted memory without changing its 18:40 trip time
Playback ends at the song boundary
Backward seeking restores the first lyric memory
The conversation sheet dismisses fully
Playback position survives complete dialog dismissal
A downward handle gesture dismisses the conversation
The second scene reveals its own location and trip time
Listen-to-scene seeks to the correct lyric memory
QA captures start from the unscrolled device shell
Close remains reliable after the interrupted-exit fix
Pointer dragging moves the scrubber continuously to the second scene
Pointer dragging reaches the second lyric scene (native slider value)
Library navigation opens the memory collection
Share opens the memory preview
The local preview link can be copied
The actual song position persists after complete dismissal
Opening conversation must preserve device viewport scrollTop=0
Conversation opens without scrolling the device viewport
Native tap opens the conversation without moving the viewport
iPhone keeps full-width content and visible player
Song end selects the 18:40 scene using the actual native range value
Seeking to the start restores the 17:23 scene

resolvedHarnessIssues.name: Pointer dragging moves the scrubber continuously to the second scene
resolvedHarnessIssues.reason: The original assertion queried a missing aria-valuenow attribute on a native range. Corrected checks read the input value; dragging reached 145 and selected Kamogawa.

resolvedHarnessIssues.name: Opening conversation must preserve device viewport scrollTop=0
resolvedHarnessIssues.reason: Locator actions at an enlarged layout viewport scrolled the device shell during automation. A native tap at normal preview size preserved scrollTop=0; screenshots were captured only after verifying scrollTop=0.

resolvedHarnessIssues.name: Conversation opens without scrolling the device viewport
resolvedHarnessIssues.reason: Same enlarged-viewport locator artifact. Native tap was tested and passed.

limitations: No audio file: playback is a simulated time and seek interaction.
Sample conversations and locations; no recording, location lookup, or backend.
Copy shares only the local preview URL; no hosted listener page.
Reduced-motion and reduced-transparency rules inspected in code; actual OS accessibility modes and physical device performance not exercised.
